home.introBody1: AlphaNorm Enviro Solutions is a Qatar-based consultancy specialised in naturally occurring radioactive material (NORM). With more than thirty years of combined expertise, our team advises operators, regulators, and stakeholders on monitoring, assessment, decontamination, and radiation safety planning.
home.introBody2: Our practice is grounded in IAEA-aligned methodology, calibrated instrumentation, and a rigorous QA Manual that ensures under 10% deviation on calibrated devices.
home.qaBody: Our internal QA Manual governs calibration, traceability, and measurement uncertainty across every survey, ensuring your decisions rest on dependable data.
home.whyBody: A focused team, internationally trained, with the credentials and partnerships needed to handle complex radiological work.
home.servicesBody: End-to-end NORM and radiation protection services tailored to your project.
home.partnersLabel: Trusted partnerships across the region and beyond
home.ctaBody: Fill out some info and we will be in touch shortly.

about.headerTitle: A licensed NORM consultancy built on three decades of practice.
about.headerLede: Authorized by Qatar's MECC and the Ministry of Commerce. IAEA-aligned methodologies. International TSAs. Proven across Qatar's energy and industrial sectors.
about.missionTitle: Empower environmental safety through measurable, IAEA-aligned practice.
about.missionBody: Our practice is grounded in calibrated instrumentation and a rigorous QA Manual that ensures < 10% deviation across every survey, so the data you rely on is data you can defend.
about.visionTitle: A region where every operator can prove their site is safe.
about.visionBody: Setting the standard for NORM consultancy in the GCC by combining international expertise with local accountability.
about.industriesBody: From upstream oil and gas to environmental authorities and academic research, our services adapt to each sector's regulatory and operational reality.
about.teamBody: A small, experienced team backed by senior academic and industry advisors.

services.indexLede: From measurement to remediation to safety planning — IAEA-aligned, accredited, and tailored to each project's exposure profile.
